_comment: Validation cases shared by the fake backend (Go) and the frontend (zod). Each case names a schema, an input in the BFF's JSON shape, and the field errors expected (empty when valid): the last message per path, as the PoC keeps (Object.fromEntries over the zod issues). Messages are the PoC's (shared/*-validation.mjs at 62319b8), with 'tenant' read as 'organization'.
